fair_value_reason: NTM EPS at Sep-2027 ~$16.1 (FY2027 adjusted ~$15.6-15.7, FY2028 ~$16.4-16.5) x 19x = ~$306 (60%), and FY2027 FCF ~$15.3B / 997.7M shares = $15.35/share at ~5.2% = ~$296 (40%); blend ~$302. This is slightly above the revised agent mean ($300.2) because agent_2's 5.5% FCF yield is at the harsh end, and slightly below my round-1 $305 because FY2027 EPS now sits at $15.6 with RBC's adjusted $15.53 as an independent anchor.
supervisor_summary: Round 2 converged: all five agents now build on FY2027 adjusted EPS of ~$15.6, FCF ~$15.3B and 18.5-19x, with fair values $296-305 (mean $300) and P(>=288) 0.51-0.536. That agreement mostly reflects my round-1 findings, not five independent views, though RBC's adjusted $15.53 independently supports the lower EPS. The only new fact is that October hike odds fell to ~35% after a soft August PCE on Sep 30. HD did not react, and December is still ~74% priced. I hold fair value at ~$302 and the ladder near the mean (P(>=288) 0.53) with low confidence: HD is a roughly fairly valued, rate-driven 19x name with a 3.2% yield and no company catalyst before ~Nov 17.
key_drivers: Rates: 10-year ~5.2%, PMMS 7.03% (Sep 24), MND 7.58% (Sep 29). After the soft August PCE (core 3.0% vs 3.3% expected), Oct hike odds fell to ~35% on Sep 30, but December is still ~74%.

Earnings base: FY2026 guidance (flat to +4% on $14.69) includes a one-time ~$685M COGS tariff refund (~$0.52/share). FY2027 adjusted consensus ~$16.0 needs ~10% underlying growth; RBC is at $15.53 and all five agents now at ~$15.6.

Demand: HD comp +1.7% vs Lowe's +0.2%, Floor & Decor -2.1%, BLDR guiding R&R -1%. LIRA sees remodel growth slowing to ~0.5% by Q2 2027, and existing-home sales are 3.98M SAAR. HD is gaining share in a flat market.
Balance sheet and cash: net debt $50.8B, no financial covenants; FY2027 FCF ~$15.3B (~$15.35/share, ~5.3% yield) plus a 3.2% dividend; buybacks resume by end Q2 FY2027 at 2.0x debt/EBITDA.
Leadership: CEO on medical leave since Aug 12; a return or a succession announcement is a two-sided event, possibly around Q3.
